description: A short check for all staff at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company, taken before the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten items from a Quayholt inbox: emails, a browser page and a sign-in prompt. The result is kept so the matching after-check (awareness_post_general_v2_ba) can show how the two compare.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
